name: Mega Digimon Assembly!
main_effect:
While your opponent has a level 6 or higher Digimon, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] 1 of your level 6 Digimon and 1 card in the hand may DNA digivolve into a level 7 Digimon card in your hand.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Return 1 level 6 or higher Digimon card from your trash to the hand. Then, add this card to the hand.
